lead_raw_text:
The structure of MgCu2NiO4 crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with a unit cell containing 32 atoms—Mg4Cu8Ni4O16—and eight independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Cu and Ni centers each adopt octahedral coordination with six O neighbors, while Mg centers are also six-coordinate to O; the oxygen environments are likewise six-coordinate, surrounded by mixed Cu, Mg, and Ni neighbors. Polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals edge-sharing between Cu and Ni octahedra, and between Ni and Mg polyhedra, with corner- and edge-sharing among Cu octahedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
